Terms

Terms of use, without the legalese where possible.

These terms cover this website only. Any system you buy is governed by the written agreement and warranties for that job.

Note for the site owner

The business details used on this page are still template values from src/config/site.ts. Before launch, replace them and have this page reviewed against your actual business practices and legal obligations in your jurisdiction. This notice disappears once the placeholder details are updated.

The short version

  • This site is general information and a planning tool — not energy, financial or legal advice.
  • Estimates are indicative models, not quotes or guarantees of savings.
  • Incentive programs change; the official sources always take precedence over anything written here.

Information, not advice

The content on this website — including the knowledge hub, FAQs and incentive summaries — is general information about solar, batteries and energy, prepared in good faith. It does not take into account your individual objectives, financial situation or needs, and it is not a substitute for advice from a qualified professional where your circumstances require it.

Estimates and calculators

The savings estimator produces indicative figures from published modelling assumptions, which are shown alongside the results. Actual outcomes depend on matters outside any model's control — your actual consumption profile, tariff changes, export limits, weather and how you operate the system. An estimate on this site is not a quotation, an offer, or a prediction of your future bills.

Incentives and third-party information

Rebates, schemes and their rules are set by governments and scheme administrators, not by this website, and they can change with little notice — including rules that apply from a future installation date. Every program described here links to its official source and records the date it was checked. Before making a decision, confirm the current position with the official source or the program administrator. Nothing on this site promises that any particular person or property is eligible for any program.

Using this website

You are welcome to use this site for personal and internal business purposes. Please do not:

  • attempt to disrupt, overload or gain unauthorised access to the site or its infrastructure;
  • scrape or reproduce substantial parts of the site content in a way that misrepresents its source;
  • use the site in breach of applicable law.

Intellectual property

The text, design, code and branding of this site belong to the site operator unless otherwise noted. Photography is used under the free-use licences of the rights holders (primarily the Pexels licence), with credits documented in the project's ASSET_SOURCES.md file.

Third-party links

This site links to websites we don't control — for example, government rebate pages and official guidance. We choose those links carefully, but we're not responsible for their content, availability or their privacy practices.

Liability

Nothing in these terms excludes or limits any guarantee, right or remedy you have under the Australian Consumer Law or any other law that cannot lawfully be excluded. To the extent the law allows, the site operator is not liable for loss arising from reliance on general information or modelled estimates taken from this website.

Where a service is supplied to you (for example, a system design or installation), the terms, warranties and consumer guarantees for that service are set out in the written agreement for that job, not on this page.

Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of Victoria, Australia, and disputes are subject to the courts of that jurisdiction.

Changes and contact

We may update these terms as the site evolves; the date at the top of this page will change when we do. Questions about these terms can be raised through the contact page.
